silence_god.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL transparent 1254-square attack VFX master for the mobile HD-2D pixel-art battle unit silence_god, 缄默之神, rank 5. Input images are this project's existing effects, references ONLY for crisp clustered pixel craftsmanship and high-rank detail; do not copy their prism spear or shield. Create one isolated LEFT-TO-RIGHT divine SILENCE SEAL WAVE: a compact dark indigo circular mute sigil with a bold ivory vertical central bar, two BROKEN concentric pale-violet sound rings collapsing inward, and a short directional indigo/ivory wave pushing right. Muted antique gold fracture marks and a few angular violet particles, strong light ivory outline so it reads on dark night as well as pale sand. The shape must read as sealing/removing sound, distinct from all shields, leaf spirals, sword cuts, and crystal lances. Elaborate rank-five effect but one coherent silhouette readable at 64px. Fully transparent RGBA on all sides, keep visible art inside central 75-80% square. No character, idol body, face, text, UI, scenery, floor, color backing, checkerboard, blur, haze, bloom fog, crop or watermark.
